prompt:
STYLE / GAME: ink and blood on real-time 3D. 2D comic-ink concept art, not an in-game sprite. Thick confident black outlines, 2-3 hard light bands, flat colour, large solid-black shadow shapes, no PBR shine, no fine noise.

SUBJECT: a lesser demon thug, not a boss, not the hunter hero. Lean, slightly hunched, ashen-grey skin, two short black horns, pointed ears, short cropped black hair, a snarling mouth with yellowed teeth, no mask. Scuffed black leather jacket over a torn dark t-shirt, dark charcoal jeans, heavy scuffed boots. His right hand holds a length of heavy steel chain; his left hand is empty (no weapon, no coin, no cards). No glowing orange veins on the forearms.

VIEW: full body, three-quarter view, feet at the bottom edge, body and face turned a little toward the left of the frame.

CANVAS: whole figure in frame with margin all round. Nothing important touching an edge.

PALETTE: ink black #0D0C0C, charcoal #2B2A2E, bone white #EEEAE0, blood red #B01818 only on small cuts or a jacket stain. Demon orange #FF6A1A only as a thin rim or horn-tip accent, not on the skin.

LIGHT: key from upper left, 2-3 hard toon light bands, large solid-black shadow shapes.

BACKGROUND: plain flat solid #0D0C0C, no scenery, no alley walls, no floor, no floor shadow, no text, no border.

AVOID: named IP, photorealism, PBR, soft gradients, fine noise, readable text, logos, a white choir robe, Gus's red suit and coin, Rook's iron mask, Vesper's candle halo, extra horns, no alley.
